name: Fire Plume Forged
summary: Krinkle Goodsteel points you to Fire Plume Ridge, a simmering volcano west in Un'Goro Crater, where the lava lake at the top is hot enough to forge the stem of a skeletal key. Afterward you carry it to Apothecary Dithers at the Bulwark in the Western Plaguelands.

sections.title: Fire for the Key Stem
sections.body: Forging the stem of the key takes two bars of thorium and fierce heat. The thorium is yours to find, but Krinkle Goodsteel can help with the heat. Your gold has bought a mold, and it only needs dipping in the lava lake on top of Fire Plume Ridge. The lava does the rest, fusing thorium and bone together.

sections.title: Back to Dithers
sections.body: Krinkle Goodsteel has done their part. To finish the key, you will need to talk to Apothecary Dithers at the Bulwark in the Western Plaguelands again. The key from the lava is still unfinished, and the work so far is preparation for an assault.

sections.title: What Lies Ahead
sections.body: Dithers calls the key quite costly, but says it is still unfinished. The foe all this work has been aimed at is in Andorhal: Araj the Summoner, a lich who ranks among the most powerful of the Scourge.

faq.q: Where is the key stem forged?
faq.answer: At the lava lake on top of Fire Plume Ridge, a simmering volcano in Un'Goro Crater, west of Krinkle Goodsteel.

faq.q: What is needed to forge the key stem?
faq.answer: The skeleton key mold and two bars of thorium. The thorium is for you to find.
Apothecary Dithers, at the Bulwark in the Western Plaguelands.
